title: Pixel Games
tagline: Free browser party games. No signup, no install — everyone plays on their own phone.

games.title: Fake Artist
games.tagline: One player doesn't know the word.
games.description: Everyone gets the secret word — except one player, the Fake. Take turns adding a single line to the shared drawing, then vote for whoever you think is bluffing. Get it right and the Fake gets one desperate guess to steal the win.
howToPlay: Create a room and share the 4-letter code (or the invite link).
Everyone draws one line in turn. The Fake only knows the category.
Vote for who you think is faking it.
If the Fake is caught, they get one guess at the word to steal the round.
features: Up to 10 players on their own devices
1–2 Fakes, 1–10 rounds, timers for turns and votes
